messages:
maria: FYI - we just started seeing a p99 latency jump and throughput drop on the v8 rollout canary (~2134567200). P99 doubled, tail CPU memcpy is through the roof. :frowning:
infra-bot: deploy: model=v8.2 canary=10% hosts=[gpu-pool-21..24] by @maria at 2134567189
aj: Can you paste the trace/profile? Is this across all hosts or just a subset? :eyes:
sandip: quick profile from gpu-pool-22 (sample, 30s):
```
- seq_len median: 32 -> 108 (canary traffic skew)
- KVCache hit rate: 0.84 -> 0.41 (prefixs longer, warmup miss)
- Kernel selection: int8_gemm_v1 (was 85%) -> cascading fallback to fp16_conv (now 60%)
- memcpy (CPU->GPU) p99: 22ms -> 98ms
- batcher: avg tokens/batch 480 -> 220 (more small long sequences => more batches)
```
lina: that matches my earlier note: v8.2 tokenizer splits long system prompts into more subtokens (we changed BPE merge thresholds). seq-length distribution shifted right on canary traffic.
dave: so we have 3 contributing factors: tokenizer increases seqlen, kernel cascade chooses slower fallback for long seqs, and KV cache effectiveness tanking -> more KV traffic and memcopies. Agree?aj: yep. Also the batcher heuristics drop tokens/batch which hurts throughput.
maria: which hosts are impacted? sandip: mostly gpu-pool-22 and gpu-pool-23 (same tenant mix), others are minor. Looks like noisy-tenant amplification: a few long-seq customers on the canary bucket.
aj: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) rollback canary 2) pin model to v8.1 on rollout pool 3) temporarily disable kernel cascade so we avoid thrashing 4) tweak batcher token thresholds. Thoughts?
lina: I vote for (1) immediate rollback of canary and (3) until we have a kernel threshold fix. Tokenizer change is a product decision; prod should be stable.
dave: I'll start rollback canary now. infra-bot, can you trigger a rollback to v8.1 for those hosts? :hammer:
infra-bot: action: rollback-start host_filter="gpu-pool-22,gpu-pool-23" target_model="v8.1" by @dave at 2134568042
ops-bot: alert: rollback completed for gpu-pool-22,gpu-pool-23 at 2134568089 (canary traffic rebalanced)
maria: after rollback p99s are trending back down on those hosts. Thanks. We still need a root-cause and remediation plan.
aj: For RCA we should: 1) confirm tokenizer delta (lina to share exact merge changes) 2) run kernel selector bench with seqlen hist from canary to reproduce kernel flip 3) quantify KVCache sensitivity to seqlen tails 4) add seqlen-aware kernel threshold and batcher hinting 5) add canary traffic seqlen monitoring/alerting.
sandip: I ran a quick offline kernel selector experiment: when median seq_len > 64, selector confidence for int8 matmul drops below 0.6 causing cascade to fp16 path ~30% of time. We should add a hysteresis and avoid cascade when confidence fluctuates quickly.
lina: attaching the tokenizer diff (pasted):
```
- BPE merge: threshold=0.5
+ BPE merge: threshold=0.42  # more splits for long prefixes
```
maria: action items assigned: sandip -> reproduce perf locally with seeded seq distributions + flamegraphs; aj -> batching heuristic prototype (seqlen-aware max_tokens/batch); lina -> coordinate with product on revert vs tweak of tokenizer; dave -> follow up on canary gating rules and add seqlen histogram to canary dashboard.
dave: noted. I'll also add an emergency guard: if KVCache hit rate drops >20% vs baseline on canary hosts, auto-pause rollout.
aj: small mitigation that might help without rollback: set env var RUNTIME_DISABLE_KERNEL_CASCADE=1 on affected pools to avoid the expensive fallback churn. But test first on one host.
maria: let's test the env var on gpu-pool-24 after rollback completes. sandip can you watch metrics and flamegraphs for 10m? sandip: will do.
ops-bot: note: canary paused globally at 2134568140 until manual resume.
maria: thanks team. We'll keep this thread for updates. Postmortem once we have repro. :white_check_mark:
